raw_text_quote.description: The exact substring from the filtered prompt this requirement maps to.

fragment_type.description: Set to 'actionable' if the requirement is specific enough to execute. Set to 'uninterpreted' if it is too vague or ambiguous. Set to 'junk' if it is conversational noise.

interpreted_action.description: If actionable, state the technical action to take. If uninterpreted, explain what is ambiguous.
